metadata.title: Infrastructure reliability incident investigation
metadata.artifact_scope_note: Evidence is aggregated query output (not raw log lines or metric samples); it contains no chat/communication records.

incident_description: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Tapline Labs (collaboration SaaS); Platform: on-premises data center DC-A, server range 10.191.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster taplin-prod (kubeadm); Ceph cluster providing block storage to a KVM virtual machine platform; one top-of-rack switch pair per rack; network work uses NET- identifiers; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
investigation_questions: Which host or node did the failure originate on? Give its hostname.
What is the IP address of the host or node where the failure originated?
Which change permanently fixed the fault? Provide its identifier.
During what hour did the first signs of the failure appear? Provide the earliest date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC format.

What is the root cause category of the incident: configuration change, software defect, hardware failure, cloud provider failure, capacity exhaustion, automation error, certificate expiry, or third-party dependency failure?
Which of the three CIA components is primarily affected: availability, integrity, or confidentiality?
According to the error volume statistics, what single service emitted the most errors? Is it the root cause or a downstream symptom?
Which change happened shortly before the incident began but did not cause it? Provide its identifier.
What change brought the service back to normal? Give its identifier.
